title: DeviceResult
description: Outcome of a fiscal device operation. UNKNOWN must never be treated as FAILED — no retry write and no automatic card refund after a timeout.

status.description: COMMITTED: document confirmed recorded. NOT_COMMITTED: definitively not recorded. UNKNOWN: recording status cannot be determined (e.g. timeout after command sent).

evidence.description: Opaque evidence string from the device (document number, raw response, etc.). May be absent.
